start_sending_instant_power.description: Get automatic instant power draw updates for a sensor.

duration.description: For how long the instant power information will be sent.

turn_on_timed.name: Turn on timed
turn_on_timed.description: Turn on a light or switch with a hardware-offloaded SCS bus timer that turns off automatically even if Home Assistant restarts.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in seconds before the device turns off automatically.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Optional hours component for custom timer duration (0-255).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Optional minutes component for custom timer duration (0-59).

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Optional seconds component for custom timer duration (0-59).

sweep_bus.name: Sweep bus status
sweep_bus.description: Triggers an active read-only status query across all bus subsystems (lighting, covers, thermoregulation, clock, and gateway diagnostics) to populate the diagnostic bus monitor ring buffer.

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.description: The gateway's MAC address (optional; defaults to all active gateways).

calibrate_cover.name: Calibrate cover travel time
calibrate_cover.description: Measures a timed cover's up and down travel times on the SCS bus and stores them: the cover is driven fully up, then fully down (timed), then fully up again (timed). Covers are calibrated one at a time per gateway.

stop_cover_calibration.name: Stop cover calibration
stop_cover_calibration.description: Stops the running travel-time calibration and cancels the queued ones; the moving cover is stopped and nothing is stored.

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.description: The gateway's MAC address (optional; defaults to all gateways).

set_cover_travel_time.name: Set cover travel time
set_cover_travel_time.description: Stores the physical travel times of a timed cover by hand instead of calibrating on the bus.

travel_time.name: Travel time
travel_time.description: Seconds for a full travel in both directions (1-180); used for whichever direction has no explicit value.

travel_time_down.name: Travel time down
travel_time_down.description: Seconds for a full closing run (1-180).

travel_time_up.name: Travel time up
travel_time_up.description: Seconds for a full opening run (1-180).

copied_from.name: Copied from
copied_from.description: The cover these times were taken from; the source is then reported as "copied" instead of "manual".

reset_cover_travel_time.name: Reset cover travel time
reset_cover_travel_time.description: Forgets the measured or manually set travel times and returns to the myhome.yaml travel_time or the 25 s default.

gateway_authentication_failed.title: Authentication failed for MyHOME gateway {gateway}
gateway_authentication_failed.description: The MyHOME gateway refused the configured OpenWebNet password or HMAC negotiation. Please check your credentials using the reconfigure flow.

unconfigured_timezone.title: Unconfigured timezone on MyHOME gateway ({gateway})
unconfigured_timezone.description:
The MyHOME gateway {gateway} is reporting an unconfigured timezone (placeholder code '999'). This can cause date and time parsing failures or dropped gateway diagnostic messages.

Please log into the gateway web UI or MyHOME Suite and configure a valid timezone, then restart the gateway.

unknown_gateway_model.title: Unknown gateway device type code ({code})
unknown_gateway_model.description: The gateway reported a hardware model code ({code}) that is unknown to the MyHOME integration (WHO=13 device type, or WHO=1013 OBJECT_MODEL when prefixed 1013-1-). Please click 'Learn More' to open a GitHub issue and attach a diagnostic trace so we can add support for this model.

bus_collision_storm.title: High SCS bus collision rate detected ({count} NACKs)
bus_collision_storm.description: An unusually high rate of bus collisions or NACK frames was detected on the SCS bus. Please check actuator wiring and physical bus termination.

gateway_identity_mismatch.title: Gateway model mismatch for {configured}
gateway_identity_mismatch.description: The gateway is configured as {configured} (source: {source}) but reports OpenWebNet device type {code}, which identifies {reported} according to {basis}. The configured model is kept; traces and diagnostics carry both values. If {reported} is what you own, open the integration's options (Configure) and pick the correct model; if {configured} is right, ignore this and please attach a trace to an issue so the code can be documented.

gateway_identity_corrected.title: Gateway model corrected to {corrected}
gateway_identity_corrected.description: The gateway was configured as {previous} but reports model code {code}, which the OpenWebNet device-type table (WHO=13) or the gateway diagnostic catalogue (WHO=1013, codes prefixed 1013-1-) identifies as {corrected}. The model, gateway profile and device registry were updated to {corrected}. If that is wrong, open the integration's options (Configure) and set the model explicitly.

incompatible_decoder_platform.title: Decoder {decoder} uses unsupported integration ({platform})
incompatible_decoder_platform.description: The configured streaming decoder {decoder} is provided by the {platform} integration, which does not accept HTTP stream URLs via play_media. For multi-room streaming (e.g. Music Assistant), configure this hardware via the DLNA Digital Media Renderer (DMR) integration instead.
